snippet.title: He Stole a Jet in GTA 6… So the Game Sent Fighter Jets #Shorts
snippet.description:
He stole a jet in GTA 6… so the game sent fighter jets after him.

GTA 6 is already live in New Zealand, and streamer Konvy went straight to a runway at night, took a red jet and flew off over Vice City with four stars. Then two military fighter jets pulled up right beside him, afterburners on. He tried to lose them over the city, took hits ("engine damage") and nosedived into downtown Vice City. Wasted. The clip passed a million views on X in about three hours.

The twist: per GameRant, the fighter jets are parked at Mile Zero Air Station, and you can steal one yourself early, right after the first mission (expect a 5-star wanted level).

GTA 6 unlocks in North America at midnight tonight. What are you stealing first: the jet, or the fighter? 👇

Gameplay credit (short excerpts, muted, cropped, with our own commentary):
• Konvy (Kick stream): clip via @Kick_Champ on X: https://x.com/Kick_Champ/status/2123045681556275702
Other footage: official Grand Theft Auto VI trailers (Rockstar Games).

Sources: @Kick_Champ clip (Nov 18, 2026; 1.4M+ video views at time of writing); Mixvale (Nov 18, 2026: streamer steals a jet and gets shot down live on stream); GameRant, "How to Get Jets in GTA 6" (Jake Fillery, Nov 18, 2026: Mile Zero Air Station, Chapter 1, 5-star wanted); FandomWire, "GTA 6: How to Get a Fighter Jet From the Military Base in Leonida" (Nov 18, 2026). No story spoilers.

#GTA6 #GTAVI #ViceCity #Konvy #RockstarGames #gaming #Shorts

2:01 Hotwiring

3:00 The gym is back

4:04 The safehouse is detailed

snippet.title: How BIG Is the GTA 6 Map? I Flew Across It in a Helicopter! | GTA 6 PS5 Pro Gameplay
snippet.description:
How BIG is the GTA 6 MAP? I flew across the massive open world of Grand Theft Auto VI in a HELICOPTER on PS5 Pro to find out! Experience breathtaking aerial views, stunning photorealistic graphics, incredible landscapes, and the enormous scale of Rockstar Games' latest open-world adventure.

From the skyscrapers of Vice City and beautiful tropical beaches to the dangerous Leonida swamps, coastal highways, and remote wilderness, discover just how massive and detailed the GTA 6 map really is!

Join me on an incredible helicopter journey across Leonida and experience the stunning world of GTA 6 from above!
